name: line-art-animation
description: Build, inspect, and render ink-on-paper SVG animations with a TypeScript kit.

interface.longDescription: Build interactive SVG figures and scenes, verify their motion, and export video. Includes TypeScript modules, runnable examples, and a local server for reading the bundled kit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Build a looping line-art SVG scene with a bakery opening at dawn.
